title: Reduced structural lock loses actuator-specific response
invariants: Equal Reduced Structural State != Equal Actuator Response
A reduced coordinate is valid only relative to the questions/actuators it preserves
ECM remodeling, mechanics, and synthetic hysteresis should not be silently collapsed when actuator specificity matters
HF01_consequence: The original F structural-lock coordinate can remain as a reduced-order synthetic abstraction for some control experiments, but external biological interpretation should separate at least E and M until their coupling and path dependence are identified.
boundary: The E/M actuator counterexample is deliberately minimal. It demonstrates information loss under aggregation and is not a quantitative AGA dynamics model.
